## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:spec` · `area:identity` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T16:03Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** a `delegated_admin`'s Invite dialog offers two roles the server always refuses.
- **Why `domain:spec`, contract first:** the client has no served datum that says which roles this caller may grant (`sys-invitation.object.ts:250`–`:256` declares one static option list). A UI fix must name the contract it reads.
  - The claimant first measures whether an existing per-caller option mechanism can carry it.
  - If a new served field is needed, the claim declares `Clause-②`, and the objectui half is filed as its own card under the self-split rule.
  - ⛔ No client-side copy of the server's role-cap rule.
- **Related:** #23945 (the same refusal's missing `code`, p3).

Claim: PM loop round 15 (`batch 2`) · 2026-10-16T17:44Z · the Invite User dialog offers only the roles the caller may grant, read from the same table the server's invitation role cap enforces. One PR, `Fixes #23957`. The server cap stays the authority; the offer is UI courtesy that follows it.

Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; this card's assignee)

Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23957` (in the cloud session's container)
Domain: `domain:spec` (triage `6219499129`); the `platform-objects` and `plugin-auth` files below are on the cross-domain exception path, one PR
Seat: `domain:spec#1` (seat post #6017)
File surface (paths on `origin/main` `d132140ebc` or later; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/spec/src/identity/`: one table of which invitation roles each issuer grade may grant, and a predicate builder for it, in the shape of `membership-reach.ts`'s `MEMBERSHIP_REACH` / `membershipReachPredicate` (constants and pure helpers only). The generated api-surface and export-origin baselines move with it.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-role-cap.ts`: the cap reads that table instead of its own ladder, with no change to what it refuses.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`, `sys-member.object.ts`, `sys-invitation.object.ts`: the three `invite_user` mirrors' `role` param declares its own `options`, each with the per-option `visibleWhen` (#5016) built from the table.
- Their tests and pins, and one `.changeset/23957-*.md`.
- ⛔ No change to who the server lets invite whom. ⛔ No client-side copy of the cap rule (triage `6219499129`). ⛔ Not #23945 (the refusal's missing `code`, `domain:services`). ⛔ No objectui file.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud` (the maintainer's word in this session's chat: 「batch 调到 5, 可以开云卡」, now 「并发降到2」), `model: default tier`. The diff touches non-test `packages/spec/src/**` and widens its exports, so the seat runs a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue.
Clause-②: yes
Responsibility: n/a — a missing served datum for an existing server refusal, found by the platform checklist run (#23878, record #23943)
Thread-read: 6219499129
Ruling-ref: none (triage `6219499129`: contract first, measure an existing per-caller option mechanism before any new one)
Serial constraints cleared:
- `batch 2`: this seat's other dev in flight is #23877 (claim `6220012215`). #23891's PR #23989 is ACCEPTed and in the queue; its dev session is archived.
- The file lists of all open PRs were read in this act: none touches the three `sys-*.object.ts` files, `membership-reach.ts`, `packages/spec/src/identity/**` or `invitation-role-cap.ts`. No open claim names these files.

| mis-close scan | `Fixes #23957` is the body's only closing keyword, and the squash message carries no other; this card closed by that PR, as intended, and nothing else did |

**Done-when, corrected.** This card's done-when line "an owner or admin still sees all of them" was wrong for one role. An admin is offered Admin, Delegated Admin and Member, not Owner, because the server's invitation role cap has always refused Owner from an admin, and this card fixed "no change to who the server lets invite whom". Offering Owner to an admin would have kept the offer-then-refuse defect for that one role. An owner sees all four, a `delegated_admin` sees Member only. The one table, `INVITATION_ROLE_GRANTORS` in `@objectstack/spec/identity`, now feeds both the cap and the three `invite_user` mirrors.

`pm:dispatched` is cleared in this act. The cloud dev session was archived at the seat's ACCEPT. No objectui card is owed: objectui at the pin honours an authored option's `visibleWhen` on an action param (contract review `6224153326`). The docs-only follow-up named in the ACCEPT is filed separately as a `domain:spec` card.
